Drafting a regex for Indian mobile numbers with optional +91 or 0 prefix and 10 digits starting with 6-9. Will provide three matching test strings and two non-matching ones.

The regex is `^(?:\+91|0)?[6-9]\d{9}$`. Three matches: `9876543210`, `09876543210`, and `+919876543210`. Two non-matches: `5876543210` (starts with 5) and `987654321` (only 9 digits).

Also verified that `919876543210` fails because the prefix is missing the plus sign. A spaced format like `+91 9876543210` would also be rejected.
